_note: Income-tax Rules, 2026 r.164(4), (12) (Gazette 271092 pp.1663 – 1664), for the tax year commencing 1 April 2026 only (r.164(1), (14)): "an individual not being an individual to whom sub-rule (2) applies or a Hindu undivided family, where the total income does not include income under the head business or profession". Excluded wherever ITR-1 applies. Furnishing: Table Sl. 3's three manners; Sl. 4's paper form names only ITR-1 and ITR-4. TY 2025-26 (W-090d, D-652): Income-tax Rules, 1962 r.12(1)(c): "an individual [not being an individual to whom clause (a) applies] or a Hindu undivided family where the total income does not include income under the head" business or profession (2017; 2018). Kinds s.139(1), s.142(1)(i), s.148 (C1a). Furnishing r.12(3) Table Sl. 1 item (c) (2017); item (b)'s paper form names only ITR-1 and ITR-4.
